clue.text: Relaxed-sounding, select member of order

indicators.note: the hyphenated 'sounding' says we want a word that sounds like the synonym for relaxed

parts.note: relaxed means calm
the select are the elite

explanation.surface: A calm-seeming, choice member of some religious order.
explanation.walkthrough: The homophone only works in a non-rhotic accent such as standard British English, where the R in the answer's first syllable is silent.
explanation.definitionFit: A Carmelite is a friar or nun of the Order of Our Lady of Mount Carmel, a Catholic religious order.

clue.text: Raise hoodie, perhaps, for early morning call

parts.note: to cock is to raise, as with an ear or eyebrow
the hoodie or hooded crow is a type of crow

explanation.surface: Pull up your hooded top to make an early wake-up call.
explanation.walkthrough: A hoodie suggests a hooded sweatshirt, but here it is the hooded crow, a grey and black bird.
explanation.definitionFit: Cockcrow is dawn, the time when the cockerel crows, literally its call at daybreak.

clue.text: Way to receive honour, wearing formal garb

indicators.note: to receive means to take in, so the way surrounds the honour

parts.note: RD is the abbreviation for road, a way
the OBE, Order of the British Empire, is a British honour

explanation.surface: Someone sets off to collect an honour dressed in formal robes.
explanation.definitionFit: To be robed is to be dressed in robes, the ceremonial gowns of formal occasions.

clue.text: Weaving together in French town, initially moaning audibly

parts.note: en is French for in

indicators.note: initially points to the opening letter of the word before it
audibly says the next word is heard, not spelt

parts.note: whining means moaning

explanation.surface: Twining together in a French town, starting to groan aloud.
explanation.walkthrough: 'French town' looks like one phrase; 'in French' gives EN and 'town, initially' T.
explanation.definitionFit: Entwining means twisting strands round each other, interlacing them like weaving.

clue.text: Set represented, after trendy promotion, as an alternative

indicators.note: after says the reworked set comes after the trendy piece

parts.note: in means fashionable

indicators.note: represented means presented again in a new form, so the letters are reworked

parts.note: an ad is a promotion

explanation.surface: A film set depicted after a fashionable advert, as an alternative.
explanation.definitionFit: Instead means in place of something else, that is as a substitute or alternative.

clue.text: Stare fixedly at London landmark before dance

indicators.note: before says the landmark comes ahead of the dance

parts.note: the London Eye is a large observation wheel on the Thames
a ball is a formal dance

explanation.surface: Gaze at the London Eye before going out to a dance.
explanation.definitionFit: To eyeball someone is to look hard at them, as when confronting or sizing them up.

clue.text: Tropical lake originally accommodating green fish?

indicators.note: accommodating means holding something inside, so the first letters surround the next piece
originally points to the opening letter of each of the two words before it

parts.note: green means raw, unripe or inexperienced

explanation.surface: A tropical lake that at first was home to a green fish.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark marks the definition as a verb used loosely: to trawl is to fish with a net dragged behind a boat.
explanation.definitionFit: Trawling is a method of fishing by dragging a wide net through the water, so to trawl is to fish.

clue.text: Upset routine, holding party in royal house

indicators.note: holding means containing, so the reversed routine surrounds the party
in a down clue upset means turned upside down, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: a rut is a dull routine
a do is a party

explanation.surface: A broken routine involving a party in a palace.
explanation.definitionFit: The Tudors were the English royal dynasty from Henry VII to Elizabeth I.

clue.text: A hanging drapery protecting Henry in fall

indicators.note: protecting means wrapped round, so the drapery surrounds Henry

parts.note: a valance is a short curtain hung round a bed frame or above a window
H is the symbol for the henry, the unit of inductance

explanation.surface: A curtain that kept Henry safe when he fell.
explanation.definitionFit: An avalanche is a sudden fall of snow and ice down a mountainside.

clue.text: Prevaricated over limits of Elgar's vocal works

indicators.note: in a down clue over means the first piece sits above the second

parts.note: to prevaricate is to evade the truth, near enough lied

indicators.note: limits of points to the first and last letters of the composer's name

parts.note: the composer's name Elgar; the 's belongs with the surface, not the letters

explanation.surface: Someone fibbed about the ends of Elgar's songs.
explanation.definitionFit: Lieder are German art songs for voice and piano, by Schubert and others.

clue.text: Old measure of copper coin

parts.note: Cu is the chemical symbol for copper
a bit is a small coin, as in a threepenny bit

explanation.surface: A historical unit of measurement for an amount of copper coinage.
explanation.definitionFit: The cubit was an ancient length unit based on the forearm, roughly eighteen inches.

clue.text: Bird female medic observed in expanse of water

parts.note: she is the female pronoun

indicators.note: observed in means seen within, so the medic sits inside the expanse of water

parts.note: a lake is an expanse of water
DR is the abbreviation for doctor

explanation.surface: A woman doctor spots a bird out on a lake.
explanation.definitionFit: The shelduck's male is the sheldrake, a large duck of coasts and estuaries.

clue.text: Analgesic fellow cathedral priest talked of

indicators.note: talked of says the word is to be heard rather than spelt

parts.note: co- means fellow or joint, as in co-worker; a dean is the senior priest of a cathedral

explanation.surface: A painkiller that some cathedral clergyman mentioned.
explanation.walkthrough: CO- means joint or fellow, as in co-pilot; a co-dean is said much like CODEINE.
explanation.definitionFit: Codeine is an opiate drug widely used as a mild painkiller, which is what an analgesic is.

clue.text: A Native American possessing a good area of land

indicators.note: possessing means having within, so the Cree hold the next two pieces

parts.note: the Cree are a Native American people

explanation.surface: A Native American who owns a good stretch of land.
explanation.definitionFit: Acreage is land measured in acres, so it denotes an extent or area of ground.

clue.text: Taking in too much about 17th-cent relaxation of religious restraints

parts.note: over can mean about, as in fighting over something
the Declarations of Indulgence of 1672 and 1687 relaxed penal laws against nonconformists and Catholics

explanation.surface: Reads like a history exam phrase about too much tolerance in the 1600s.
explanation.walkthrough: The Declarations of Indulgence were issued by Charles II and James II to suspend laws against religious dissenters.
explanation.definitionFit: Overindulgence is excessive consumption of food or drink, consuming more than is good for you.

clue.text: Hedonist's heroic article about Yorkshire river

definitions.note: the possessive acts as an adjective: belonging to a hedonist, which the adjective answer means

indicators.note: about means around, so the heroic word and the article together surround the river

parts.note: epic means heroic in scale
an is the indefinite article
the Ure is a river in North Yorkshire

explanation.surface: A pleasure-seeker's grand piece of writing about a Yorkshire river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heroic article' reads as one phrase but is two pieces, EPIC and AN, which go either side of URE.
explanation.definitionFit: Epicurean describes devotion to sensual pleasure, especially fine food and drink, as a hedonist's life is.

clue.text: Alpine plant Swedes lie about

indicators.note: about here means scattered around, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Swedish people are said to rest among a mountain flower.
explanation.definitionFit: Edelweiss is a white woolly flower of high European mountains, the Alps especially.

clue.text: Laurel placed on top of Bob's carriage

indicators.note: in a down clue placed on top of means the first piece sits above the second

parts.note: Stan Laurel, the comedian of Laurel and Hardy
Bob Hope, the comedian; the 's reads as 'is' joining to the definition

explanation.surface: A laurel wreath set on the roof of Bob's coach.
explanation.walkthrough: Laurel and Bob are both comedians' names, Stan Laurel and Bob Hope.
explanation.definitionFit: A stanhope is a light open horse-drawn carriage, named after the clergyman it was built for.

clue.text: Girl's gruff sound fast brought about this writer's grumpiness

parts.note: Di is a girl's name, with the 's kept
a grunt is a gruff noise

indicators.note: brought about means placed around, so the fast surrounds the writer

parts.note: Lent is the Christian period of fasting
the setter refers to themselves as me

explanation.surface: A girl's gruff noise and quick reaction caused the writer's bad mood.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fast' looks like an adjective for quick but is the noun: the fast of Lent.
explanation.definitionFit: Disgruntlement is a state of sulky dissatisfaction, the same mood as grumpiness.

clue.text: Out of bed, the worse for wear, and tetchy

parts.note: up means risen from bed
tight is slang for drunk, which is one sense of the worse for wear

explanation.surface: A hungover person who has just got up and is irritable.
explanation.definitionFit: Uptight means tense and irritable, close to tetchy or touchy.

clue.text: Allowed to set up brilliant communications satellite

indicators.note: in a down clue set up means turned to read upwards, so backwards

parts.note: let means allowed
a star is a brilliant performer

explanation.surface: Permission is given to install a bright orbiting satellite.
explanation.definitionFit: Telstar, launched in 1962, was the first satellite to relay live television across the Atlantic.

clue.text: Wife in London area that hurt child's dog

indicators.note: in places the wife inside the following letters

parts.note: Bow is a district of east London
ow is the cry of 'that hurt!'

explanation.surface: A wife in a London district complains that the child's dog hurt her.
explanation.definitionFit: Bow-wow is nursery talk for a dog, imitating its bark.

clue.text: Luxurious work university hired out

parts.note: op is short for opus, a work
lent means handed over for temporary use, near enough to hired out

explanation.surface: A lavish piece of work that a university rented out.
explanation.definitionFit: Opulent describes rich, lavish surroundings, synonymous with being luxurious and costly.

clue.text: Man from part of Holstein regularly going north

indicators.note: going north says the hidden letters are read backwards
part of says the letters are found within the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A man from some region of Holstein who heads north often.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft took 'Man from part' as the definition; 'from' is a link and 'part of' signals the hidden letters, so the definition is just 'Man'. Read upwards, holstEIN REgularly gives a boy's name.
explanation.definitionFit: Ernie is a man's first name, short for Ernest, so it stands for an example of a man.

clue.text: Despicable dope!

definitions.meaning: first meaning: low and mean, utterly contemptible
second meaning: slang for the inside information on something

explanation.walkthrough: The exclamation makes it sound like an insult to an idiot, but dope here is slang for information.
explanation.definitionFit: Low-down as an adjective is contemptible; the lowdown as a noun is the true facts on something.

clue.text: Right character to house a stripy African ruminant

indicators.note: to house means to hold inside, so the two pieces before it contain the next letter

parts.note: OK means all right
pi is a Greek character

explanation.surface: The right letter to give a home to an African animal.
explanation.definitionFit: The okapi is a forest animal of Congo, related to the giraffe, with striped legs.

clue.text: Specific time you and I finally see man on board

parts.note: you and I together are we

indicators.note: finally points to the last letter of the next word

parts.note: a knight is a chess piece, a man on the board

explanation.surface: We arrange a particular time to finally watch a chess game.
explanation.definitionFit: A weeknight is any evening from Monday to Friday, a particular kind of time slot.

clue.text: Your compiler's turn to catch a butterfly, perhaps

indicators.note: to catch means to hold inside, so the letters gather in the single letter

parts.note: the setter is speaking: I'm, contracted from I am
a go is a turn in a game

explanation.surface: The setter says it's their go at netting a butterfly.
explanation.definitionFit: An imago is the final adult stage of an insect, and a butterfly is one example of that stage.

clue.text: Recoil, finding head of caterpillar in drink

indicators.note: in places that letter inside the drink

parts.note: wine is a drink

indicators.note: head of points to the opening letter of the next word

explanation.surface: Someone flinches on spotting a caterpillar's head in their glass.
explanation.definitionFit: To wince is to flinch or draw back in pain or distaste, a sense of recoil.

clue.text: Act has pronounced polish, one may admit

parts.note: a turn is an act in a variety show

indicators.note: pronounced says the next word is heard rather than spelt

parts.note: style here means polish or refinement

explanation.surface: A performance whose polish is striking, one might concede.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pronounced' poses as 'marked' and 'admit' as 'confess', but admit means let in.
explanation.definitionFit: A turnstile is a revolving gate that lets people enter one at a time, so it admits them.
